bullets.text: CR just below 90 generated $356M in pretax profit, widely distributed across products and states; operating cash flow positive for a 101st consecutive quarter.
Capital position expanded nearly $90M ($175M over February), remaining several hundred million above prudent levels; recognized $223M in OTTI, primarily in bank preferred stocks.
Total NPW +1% as customer growth outpaced lower average premiums; private passenger auto NPW +3%, while Commercial Auto fell 11% amid challenging economic conditions.
Direct auto NPW grew 9% and PIF 10%, with Internet production showing YOY increases; Agency auto contributed -1% NPW and -2% PIF, with new business run rates matching year-ago levels.

Private passenger auto PIF grew 3% YOY. Significant increases in new prospects and sales signaled changing market conditions; management believes cost-conscious consumers are reevaluating established insurance relationships.

Management actively de-risked the investment portfolio to reduce capital position volatility, further reducing common equity holdings and increasing cash and U.S. Treasury allocations amid continued asset valuation declines.
Claim severity trends remained relatively mild, except PIP in no-fault states; frequency was lower YOY, though slowly climbing from third-quarter 2008 lows.

Most rate actions taken across states and products were slightly positive during the first quarter. Management noted that although vigilance in market conditions remains necessary, the quarter was relatively normal.
The "Name Your Price" offering is about to go national after nearly a year of promising rollout; management expressed increased confidence in maintaining excellent claims quality at lower costs.
Robust advertising campaign builds brand momentum; consumer research indicates clear brand perceptions, creating an opportune time to be seen as both credible and good value.
